# Davonium Technologies — Public information guide

Davonium Technologies builds software, applications, digital products, websites, web tools, and tailored technology experiences for people and organisations worldwide.

## Product status
- Ready2Go Learning: in development; learning and exam practice for JAMB candidates and students. https://www.davoniumtech.com/docs/guides/ready2go-learning
- Marvel Chat: initial build complete; active development continues. https://www.davoniumtech.com/docs/guides/marvel-chat
- Davonium Nexus: in development; project visibility and client handoff workspace. https://www.davoniumtech.com/docs/guides/davonium-nexus

## Search and security
- Sitemap: https://www.davoniumtech.com/sitemap.xml
- Crawler policy: https://www.davoniumtech.com/robots.txt
- Security contact: https://www.davoniumtech.com/.well-known/security.txt

We keep public product status and guide links aligned. Search submission and crawler access help discovery but do not guarantee crawling, indexing, ranking, or AI citations. Privacy, terms, and browser-storage policies remain drafts pending review against our actual practices.
